description: This source file is a C++ header defining the interface for IAVBufferHelper, an abstract class providing memory management functions such as mapping, unmapping, and copying secure buffers. It also declares a factory function to obtain instances of the helper.

classes.name: IAVBufferHelper
classes.description: An abstract class that provides methods for buffer handling, including mapping and copying buffers via handles, designed for extensions by concrete implementations.

methods.name: mapHandle
methods.description: Maps memory from a handle, returning a pointer to the mapped data and its size.

methods.name: unmapHandle
methods.description: Unmaps memory associated with a handle.

methods.name: getAllocationSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the memory allocated for a given handle.

methods.name: bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle,void * data,uint32_t size)
methods.description: Writes data into a secure buffer identified by a handle; default implementation returns false.

methods.name: bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo,uint64_t handleFrom,CopyMap map,uint32_t mapSize)
methods.description: Copies data between secure buffers using a specified map; default returns false.

ctags.name: copySecureHandleWithMap
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo, uint64_t handleFrom, CopyMap map, ui/

ctags.name: writeSecureHandle
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle, void* data, uint32_t size) { return false; }$/
